title: S14T03 - Add query pushdown and indexes for hot paths
description: Ready/list/search hot paths should avoid whole-state scans and expensive view construction before filters and limits.
acceptanceCriteria: Store/runtime APIs support filtered, sorted, limited ready/list queries with stable ordering and indexed lookup for status, label, reservation, source, and updatedAt.
closedReason: Query pushdown and index plan documented and verified.
